Container.Name: plex-playlist-hub
Container.Overview:
Plex Playlist Hub is a self-hosted, multi-user playlist management and synchronization platform for your local Plex Media Server and Plexamp.
Key Features: - Multi-User Plex Home Routing: Share playlists with specific users, kids, or the entire home. - Zero Spotify API Key Required: Built-in scraper allows seamless public Spotify playlist syncing without developer accounts. - 1-Click Bookmarklet & Clipboard Import: Easily import personal Spotify playlists and Liked Songs into Plexamp. - Lidarr Missing Track Automation: Expose missing tracks via RSS/JSON feeds to automatically monitor and inject tracks back into playlists. - Beautiful Dark Web UI: Interactive web dashboard on port 5250 with Plex OAuth sign-in.

Config.Name: WebUI & API Port
Config.Description: Web Dashboard and REST API port. Accessible in your browser.

Config.Name: AppData Storage
Config.Description: Persistent directory for the SQLite database, sessions, sync logs, and missing track exports.

Config.Name: Plex Server URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Plex Media Server, using your server's LAN IP and port 32400. IMPORTANT: Do NOT use localhost on bridge networking.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Plex Admin X-Plex-Token. Optional initially if using the Web Dashboard Plex OAuth PIN login, but required for background daemon sync.

Config.Name: Plex Music Library Section
Config.Description: Name of your Plex music library section.

Config.Name: Plex Machine Identifier
Config.Description: Plex server machine identifier for multi-user access pinning. Leave blank to auto-detect.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Random 32+ character string for signing session cookies. Leave blank to auto-generate.

Config.Name: Lidarr Feed Token
Config.Description: Secret security token to protect your RSS/JSON missing tracks feeds when connecting Lidarr.

Config.Name: Spotify Client ID
Config.Description: Optional Spotify Developer Client ID. Leave BLANK to use the built-in keyless scraper!

Config.Name: Spotify Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional Spotify Developer Client Secret. Leave BLANK to use the built-in keyless scraper!

Config.Name: Lidarr Server URL
Config.Description: Optional base URL of your Lidarr server (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8686). Do NOT use localhost.

Config.Name: Lidarr API Key
Config.Description: Optional Lidarr API Key (from Lidarr Settings - General - Security).

Config.Name: Sync Interval (Seconds)
Config.Description: Automatic background sync interval in seconds. Default is 14400 (every 4 hours). Set to 86400 for once daily.

Config.Name: Track Match Threshold
Config.Description: Fuzzy title matching threshold between 0.0 and 1.0 (default 0.9).
